description: Get a screenshot of the running Node.js app as a base64 JPEG data URL. Useful to visually confirm the app is alive without HTTP-probing. Set `refresh=true` to force a fresh screenshot. Manager-private.

refresh.description: Ask the manager to re-screenshot the page (slower). Default false (cached).

name: infomaniak_nodejs_app_thumbnail

blob.description: Data URL (data:image/jpeg;base64,...) ready to embed in markdown.
